input.quote: Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: We have an affiliate/successor assignment right without consent, Vendor needs our consent (never to a competitor), and Section 24.4 bars any Vendor termination, suspension or repricing on our change of control. Preferred position met.

input.quote: Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.
input.rationale: We own Customer Data and Deliverables with a Vendor assignment, Vendor retains only Vendor Technology subject to the perpetual licence in Section 13.2, and Section 14.4 rules out joint ownership. Preferred position met.

input.quote: 13.1 Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
input.rationale: The Services grant is revocable at Vendor's discretion and expressly excludes Affiliates and contractors with no path to add them — walk-away territory — even though Sections 13.2 and 13.3 provide better terms for paid-up software and transfers. We extended the grant to Affiliates and contractors and limited revocation to the Section 13.3 uncured-breach standard.

input.quote: no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours
input.rationale: Annual cap, 30 days' notice, off-site independent auditor under confidentiality, Vendor-borne costs unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and no direct access to our systems. Preferred position met.
